Ruling: batch #317 item 1 · letter A · maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-11T11:20Z

Director seat, summon #36, `session_019fWAt2renophxLVg5aJXMH` (GitHub `hotlong`; written as `objectstack-fleet[bot]` via the relay). Presented in batch #317 as item 1, from the epic seat's decision card (`epic:#15194`, `session_01Rerax7QTjKMPCUZxQUtPFR`). The epic seat recommended A, falling back to C; the U2 dev (report 6106844492) recommended C. This seat recommended **A**, falling back to **B**, and the maintainer answered 「同意」 to the batch.

Thread-read: none (0 comments on this card at both reads). Freshness: body unchanged since filing; labels `priority:p1`, `security`, `needs-user-decision`, `domain:services`, `target:v18`, `area:access`; no assignee.

The card's premise commands, re-run on `origin/main` (`b7cd1af9df`):
- `sys_position_permission_set` appears in `resolve-authz-context.ts` only in the header comment (`:16`). The resolver does not read it.
- `position` is registered with `allowOrgOverride: false` (`metadata-plugin.zod.ts:1118`).
- The only `isDefault: true` permission set in `examples/*/src/security` is the showcase's own (`permission-sets.ts:302`; `:288` is a comment).

**Added measurement, closing part of the card's confidence gap:** `objectstack-ai/hotcrm` `main` `1d7148bf`, the one marketplace package this seat can read, declares no `isDefault: true` permission set. Its `isDefault: true` hits are pages only. It binds sets to positions by name (`src/sales/profiles/service-agent.profile.ts`, header). So the installed-package track has 0 producers, published package included. cloud is still unmeasured.

## The ruling

**A: a package's `isDefault: true` permission set reaches every signed-in user only through ONE explicit, deployment-level acceptance by an admin holding `manage_metadata`, and that acceptance takes effect.**
- The security plugin re-derives `everyone` as the baseline plus the accepted package defaults, and recomputes it on accept, uninstall and publish.
- The definition side carries the high-risk gate (ADR-0090 D7).
- Reconciliation reads the definition.
- The acceptance record belongs to the default organization.
- 2c's "sealed" wording gets a stated reading: an acceptance changes the derivation's input. No caller writes the anchor's definition.
- The spec texts (`confirmAudienceBindingSuggestion` "writes the binding", and the package-level `isDefault` note "an admin confirms in Setup") are kept and made true. They are rewritten only where the mechanism's wording changes.
- **ADR-0090 D5 stands unchanged**: "Packages suggest, admins confirm … never auto-bound."

Why A, on ① alone:
- **Mainstream enterprise platforms all require an explicit admin act before a package widens user access, and none grants every user at install.**
  - Salesforce asks the installer "admins only / all users / specific profiles".
  - ServiceNow and Dynamics leave role assignment to the admin.
  - C would reverse D5, so C is out.
- **Between A and B, B leaves no way at all to give every member a package's set.** The two audience anchors are sealed (2c), so an admin could only assign user by user. "Install an app and let the members use it" is a marketplace's first flow.
- **The protocol already promises A's behaviour.** The implementation is what drifted. Aligning the consumer with the protocol is the rule, not deleting the protocol.

②④ lean B (0 producers measured; A adds a deployment-level record and a recompute path), and do not flip it. This is a security boundary on the human floor, and B removes the only "all members" route.

- ⛔ Not taken:
  - **B** (remove the path and refuse `isDefault` on installed packages);
  - **C** (declared means granted to everyone, high-risk filtered, which reverses D5).

Workload (#22597's rule):
- A: #15204 stage U2's build, about 1.2–1.8k lines plus tests, `Clause-②: yes`, under one contract review. Its landing meets release precondition (d) and unblocks 6b-2.
- B would have been about 2.5k deletions plus a refusal and ADR edits.
- C would have been about 2.5k deletions plus 0.2–0.4k lines and a D5 reversal.

Prior rulings read: ADR-0090 D5/D7/D9 · ADR-0131 D3 (and §5's rejection of per-organization binding rows) · #22621 → A (definitions by `manage_metadata`, organization admins assign only) · #22601 → B (no transitional piece) · 2c (#22736) and its Landed record 6105781131 · #15204 stage-1 ACCEPT 6102862135 · U2 measurement 6106844492. 自检: 只看①选 A;②③④ 是否翻转:否(② ④ 偏 B,但安全边界在人工地板,且 B 拿掉市场包「给全员」的唯一路径;③ 偏 A,人工闸)。置信缺口: cloud and the published marketplace catalogue beyond HotCRM are unmeasured. A real `isDefault` producer there changes nothing in A.

## State

- `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` in this act, keeping `priority:p1`, `security`, `domain:services`, `target:v18` and `area:access`. The `Ruled:` line is added to the body; the body carries no filing-time ⛔ line to strike.
- The `epic:#15194` seat dispatches #15204's U2 build stage on this ruling, then closes this card as that stage's decision record. ⛔ No seat claims this card on its own.
